editorial.name: Zard UI
editorial.descriptionZh: Angular 版的 shadcn/ui：用 Signals 和 TailwindCSS v4 写的开源组件、区块与图表，站上按 Docs / Components / Blocks / Charts / Themes / Typeset 分开。
editorial.takeawayZh: 复制 Angular 组件的 Tailwind 源码
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏是 beta / Docs / Components / Blocks / Charts / Themes / Typeset 七项加一个 Search documentation... 输入框。首屏大标题 The Next Level for Your Angular Projects.，上面压着一枚 Build your design system in the browser 胶囊标签，下面三列并排全是组件预览：左列摆着 Button / Secondary / Outline 按钮、Name 与 Message 输入框、Badge 与开关控件，中列是 Contribution History 柱状图（Dec 到 Apr 五根）加 UPCOMING May 2024 与 SAVINGS PLAN Accelerated 两块小卡，右列是 Scan to connect your mobile device 的二维码和一张 New Chat 对话框。页脚落款 Made with ❤ in Brazil.

reasons.statement: 站点自我说明是 The shadcn/ui experience, built natively for Angular，并且同时给出 Components、Blocks、Charts、Themes 四个层次，属于设计系统与完整组件套件而不是单一组件库。
页面 description 写 Free and open-source UI components built with Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS，用户直接拿走的是组件源码而非模板或案例。
